dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product splits a long list into numbered pages — search results, the posts of a blog, the rows of a table — and offers a row of page numbers with the current one marked, previous and next, sometimes first and last, and a short form that says only which page of how many where the row has no room. A dense table pages with a smaller row than a page of results.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a pagination reads: the gap between its items; an item's height per size, its least width, inline padding and corners; the text style of a page number and of the short form's sentence; the arrows' size; the color of the ellipsis and of the short form's sentence; the timing of a state change; and the colors of an item's fill, number, arrow and state layer, for a page and for the current page, at rest and in each state.
rules: A pagination moves through the numbered pages of one list: page numbers with the current one marked, previous and next, and first and last where the product asks for them. It is not for the page before and after in a sequence of titled pages: that is Previous and next links.
The current page is marked by its fill and by aria-current, never by color alone.
Previous, next, first and last are icon-only and named by the product's words; the arrows are drawn by the component and mirror in a right-to-left layout.
Pages that do not fit are left out behind an ellipsis, which is not a control. The number of places stays the same from page to page.
State tokens are valued by the design system's pattern rules; override one token or replace the rule.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never style the items by hand.

gap.$description: Space between two items of the row, and between the short form's sentence and the controls beside it.

height.$description: An item's height, per size, and its least width: a page number of one digit stands in a square.

padding-inline.$description: Space on each side of a page number that is wider than the square: a number of three digits or more.

shape.$description: The corners of an item, and of its focus ring. Fully rounded in the default system, as a button is: a page of one digit is a circle.

typescale.$description: A page number. Its digits are drawn at one width, so that the row keeps its width from page to page.

size.$description: The box of the arrows of previous, next, first and last.

color.$description: The ellipsis that stands for the pages left out. It is not a control and has no state.

padding-inline.$description: Space on each side of the short form's sentence, between it and the controls.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A page that is not the current one has no fill at rest; the surface behind it shows through.

color.$description: The fill of a page and of previous, next, first and last. None at rest: it is where hover, focus and press are drawn.
The arrows of previous, next, first and last.
The color hover, focus and press mix into an item's container: its number's.
The fill of the current page, which marks it together with aria-current. The selected segment's color.
The number of the current page.
Unused in the default system, where the current page draws no arrow; named so that every part has the same parts.
The color hover, focus and press mix into the current page's container.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple: the pressed layer grows from the point of contact over this time, with state-easing. Unused by the other choices.
